adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` simply re-renders the serialized `@embedding` and does not persist any changes. Routes add a PUT endpoint (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`). On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines a `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, which would hit that no-op PUT if invoked. While the current `embedding.hbs` template doesn’t reference `saveChanges` (so it may be unused), the diff does introduce a dead/no-op update endpoint and client action, which is a concrete completeness/architecture concern rather than a functional defect shown by the diff.
